_not_minted_deliberately.banner: The prototype's amber banner (L169-171, 'มีการเปลี่ยนอะไหล่ — ระบบจะสร้างใบเสนอราคาส่งลูกค้าผ่าน LINE OA อัตโนมัติ') is DROPPED, not keyed. It promises an automation that does not exist: nothing auto-raises a pmQuote (POST /pm/quotes is a manual route, apps/api/src/routes/pm.ts L830) and LINE is a verified no-op stub (lineNotifyStub L218-220, B-108b). A missing VALUE can be em-dashed; a false PROMISE cannot. Minting a key for it would leave the screen one edit away from making the claim again — so the sidecar test asserts no sidecar value contains 'LINE OA' or 'ใบเสนอราคา'. See BLOCKERS.md B-281.
_not_minted_deliberately.partsValue: 'Safety Edge Sensor MX-SE12' / '1 ชุด · 3,200 ฿' (L163) are mock DATA, not keys — and money. pm_workorder has no parts column (parts live on pmQuotes.parts), so the kept label renders over an em-dash.
_not_minted_deliberately.woNumber: 'PMWO-2569-0312' (L150 eyebrow) is mock data, not a key. pm_workorder stores no document number and workOrderWire exposes none, so the eyebrow em-dashes (the pm_jobs agg omits the same field for the same reason).
